analysis.investment_thesis: Methodhub is a tiny, leveraged IT services company with dangerously low promoter holding (26.85%) and debt-heavy balance sheet — it fails my most basic quality filters. The explosive revenue jump (35→57→135 Cr) without matching operating cash flow (only 5 Cr) suggests earnings quality issues I cannot accept.
key_strengths: Headline ROE 42.7% and ROCE 31.1% look strong on paper
P/E of 14x is not demanding for the reported growth
key_risks: Promoter holding only 26.85% — far below my 55% comfort threshold
Debt/Equity ~0.68 (borrowings 39 Cr vs equity 57 Cr) — unacceptable leverage
OCF 5 Cr vs Net Profit 11 Cr — poor cash conversion, possible receivables buildup
red_flags: Equity jumped from 11 Cr to 57 Cr in one year — recent capital raise/IPO dilution
Finance cost 5 Cr eating ~30% of operating income
Revenue nearly 4x in two years — too volatile for a steady compounder
Micro-cap 144 Cr with no visible moat in commoditised IT services
analysis.detailed_analysis:
This company does not pass my first-principles filters. Promoter holding at 26.85% is a dealbreaker — I want owner-operators with skin in the game, holding 55%+ and stable. Debt of 39 Cr against 57 Cr equity (and that equity only reached 57 Cr after a recent raise — it was 11 Cr last year) means the underlying business is actually highly leveraged. Finance costs of 5 Cr consume nearly a third of the 17 Cr operating income. The optical ROE of 42.7% is flattered by the small historical equity base and will compress meaningfully on the new 57 Cr equity.

The revenue trajectory (35→57→135 Cr) is the opposite of what I look for — I want steady 12–18% CAGR, not a 4x jump in two years, which in small-cap IT services often reflects aggressive revenue recognition, low-margin staff augmentation, or acquisitions. Critically, operating cash flow actually fell from 7 Cr (2023) to 5 Cr (2025) while reported profit tripled — this is a classic earnings-quality warning. Add to this: it is a tiny IT services shop with no brand, no consumer franchise, and no moat. This is exactly the kind of glamour micro-cap I avoid. AVOID.
